"""Frozen-instance acrylic stroke copy. All paint is deposited through robot actions."""
import os,json,time,math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
OUT=Path('/app/output')

def execute(s,plan,depth=1.15,speed=.030,lag=.077):
 p=s.primitives();current_color=None;t0=time.time()
 def move(pos,speed=.16,settle=5):
  r=p['move_tip'](pos,speed=speed,settle=settle)
  if r['ik_failures']:print('IK move failures',r,flush=True)
 def dip(c):
  x,y=s.wells()[c]['center_xy']
  here=s.tip_pose()[0];move([here[0],here[1],.065],.10,3)
  move([x,y,.065],.20,5);move([x,y,.023],.045,6);move([x,y,.065],.12,4)
 for i,st in enumerate(plan):
  c=st['color'];xy=np.array(st['xy'],float)
  # Every contact is freshly loaded, keeping the preset's stroke progression bounded.
  dip(c)
  xyz=np.array([[*s.geo.mm_to_world(*v),.020-depth/1000] for v in xy])
  move([*xyz[0,:2],.045],.20,5);move(xyz[0],.035,6)
  ds=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(xyz,axis=0),axis=1);dd=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(ds)]
  n=max(1,math.ceil(dd[-1]/(speed/20)));ts=np.linspace(0,dd[-1],n+1)
  qprev=s.ik(xyz[0])[0]
  for j in range(1,len(ts)):
   target=np.array([np.interp(ts[j],dd,xyz[:,k]) for k in range(3)])
   q,ok,err=s.ik(target,q_init=qprev)
   if not ok:raise RuntimeError(f'IK failed at stroke {i}, {err}')
   action=q+lag*20*(q-qprev)
   s.step(action);qprev=q
  # Bring the command back to the endpoint before lifting.
  for _ in range(5):s.step(qprev)
  move([*xyz[-1,:2],.045],.05,5)
  if i%10==0 or i==len(plan)-1:
   print('stroke',i+1,'/',len(plan),'steps',s.n_steps,'elapsed',round(time.time()-t0,1),flush=True)
   Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT/'progress.png')
   # Save a valid partial trajectory while the run is in progress.
   s.save_trajectory(np.array(s._since_reset),OUT/'partial.npz')
 p['hold'](10)

def main():
 import argparse
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--depth',type=float,default=1.15);ap.add_argument('--speed',type=float,default=.030);ap.add_argument('--lag',type=float,default=.077);ap.add_argument('--plan',default=str(OUT/'plan.json'));args=ap.parse_args()
 plan=json.load(open(args.plan));s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False);s.reset();s.record_start()
 execute(s,plan,args.depth,args.speed,args.lag)
 actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,OUT/'trajectory.npz',meta={'source':'gen.py','plan':args.plan,'depth_mm':args.depth,'speed_mps':args.speed,'lag_s':args.lag})
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT/'painting.png');np.save(OUT/'painting_ink.npy',s.ink())
 np.savez_compressed(OUT/'realized_strokes.npz',**{str(i):st['samples'] for i,st in enumerate(s.strokes())})
 print('actions',len(actions),'contacts',len(s.strokes()),'state',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
 status=s.status();json.dump(status,open(OUT/'status.json','w'),indent=2);print(json.dumps(status),flush=True);s.close()
if __name__=='__main__':main()
